description: This file contains unit tests for WebSocket JSON communication using the WPEFramework framework. It defines message classes, socket server and client classes, and a test case that verifies JSON message exchange over WebSocket connections.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a JSON message with event type and event data, used for WebSocket communication.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A pool of Message objects used to manage JSON message instances efficiently.

classes.name: JsonSocketServer
classes.description: A WebSocket server class that handles incoming JSON messages and manages connection state.

classes.name: JsonSocketClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client class that sends and receives JSON messages.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Returns whether the socket is idle.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes of the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends JSON messages over the WebSocket.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the server.
